name: OpenVLA
summary: Open 7B-parameter vision-language-action model that maps camera images and language instructions to robot actions, trained on an Open X-Embodiment mixture. The code and the trained weights carry different terms.

knowledge.rationale: A trained policy that produces robot behaviour (actions).

publisher: OpenVLA authors (Stanford, UC Berkeley, Toyota Research Institute, Google DeepMind and others)

license.name: Code MIT; weights subject to the Llama Community License

licenses.name: MIT License (all code in the repository)
licenses.reviewNote: As granted by the licence text; dependencies and third-party components not assessed. Not legal advice.

licenses.name: Llama Community License (inherited from the Llama 2 base model)
restrictions: The authors state the pretrained models may inherit restrictions from their base models and are subject to the Llama Community License.

aiModel.baseModel: Prismatic prism-dinosiglip-224px VLM (DINOv2 + SigLIP vision, Llama 2 language model)

limitations.text: LIBERO success rates are reported by the model authors after fine-tuning (3 seeds × 500 rollouts) and have not been independently replicated here.
Weights are subject to the Llama Community License, which differs from the MIT licence of the code.

engineeringUses: Prototyping language-conditioned manipulation on a new robot by fine-tuning a pretrained policy
Serving as a baseline when comparing robot-learning approaches on a benchmark
